interpretation.builtin_components: Horn grammar/compiler, connector DSL operators and typed execution semantics are predefined, not learned legal rules.
interpretation.learned_quantity: Observed collisions can support selecting metadata obligations and retaining parameterized connector structure; count only the recorded evidence.
interpretation.reuse_boundary: Showing a prior pattern in a real prompt, independently rediscovering it, and executing matching graph structure are separate evidence. A structural match alone does not prove causal transfer.
interpretation.train_route: FormalRun.train calls ingest_source and source learning. The library-dependent apply_interfaces policy is in route_prediction, which is not invoked by train; evaluation remains closed.
interpretation.A_boundary: Conservative residual repair is actual A control flow but not evidence of a nontrivial separating batch. Fixed-grammar stability is not learned legal-skill success.
interpretation.offline_boundary: Previous artificial residual/number/entity checks remain offline implementation evidence; they are not new real-model or later-source transfer results.
